hooks.command: echo '⚠️  WARNING: Writing .env file. Ensure .gitignore includes .env' >&2
echo '⚠️  WARNING: Taskmaster files should never be committed to git' >&2 && grep -q '.taskmaster' .gitignore 2>/dev/null || (echo '❌ ERROR: .taskmaster/ not in .gitignore!' >&2 && exit 2)
echo '❌ ERROR: Attempting to stage .env file! This will expose secrets.' >&2 && exit 2
echo '❌ ERROR: Attempting to stage .taskmaster/ files! These should not be committed.' >&2 && exit 2

echo '🔍 Pre-push check: Verifying no secrets in staged files...' >&2 && git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.env$|\.key$|\.pem$' && (echo '❌ ERROR: Sensitive files detected in commit!' >&2 && exit 2) || echo '✓ No secrets detected' >&2
git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.env$|\.key$|\.pem$|secrets/' && (echo '❌ ERROR: Attempting to commit sensitive files!' >&2 && exit 2) || true
grep -q '.env' .gitignore && grep -q '.taskmaster' .gitignore && echo '✓ .gitignore includes .env and .taskmaster' || echo '⚠️  .gitignore may be missing critical entries' >&2
echo '✓ Commit created successfully' && git log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null | head -1
echo '🚀 Claude Code Session Started' && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/📍 Branch: /' || true
echo '👋 Session ended. Remember to commit any pending changes!' >&2
